A '''second battle''' took place in the [[Sepan system/Legends|Sepan system]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].

==Prelude==
During the [[Sepan campaign]], a group of [[Ripoblus (people)|Ripoblus]] refugees, mostly scientists, were fleeing the [[Sepan Civil War]], using a stolen [[Patrol ship/Legends|System patrol craft]] [[Glas]] and two [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|Lambda-class shuttles]]. [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces under the command of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Harkov]], offered the refugees asylum and they agreed to dock with the [[Victory I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory I''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Protector (Victory I-class)|''Protector'']] as the Glass was not hyperdrive capable. They came under attack from [[Ripoblus government]] forces and [[Dimok (people)|Dimok]] forces were not far behind.

==Battle==
[[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE Interceptor]] [[Gamma Squadron/Legends|Gamma Squadron]] which included [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] intercepted the Ripoblus [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]] and Shuttles attacking the refugees. Not long into the conflict Dimok Y-wings and Lambda shuttles entered with the same mind of stopping the refugees, but both were ultimately unsuccessful. Glas then docked with the Protector and all personal abandoned the craft, leaving it on autopilot to drift off into space. Suddenly 4 Ripoblus [[Delta-class JV-7 escort shuttle|Escort shuttles]] entered and attacked the Protector but all were destroyed. The two Shuttles Nazaar soon docked into the hanger of the Protector

==Aftermath==
The Refugees were grateful for the asylum offered by Harkov.

==Behind the scenes==
The conflict is described in the game ''Star Wars: TIE Fighter''. It is Battle 2 Mission 3 in the game.
